method: My main task this week was to create a pixel-style exploded drawing. So I looked up pixel art tutorials and analyses the case study provided by professor.
title: my first week in creative technologies
introduction: This week, I met my tutor and classmates, learned course requirements and week 1 content. I also attended a helpful lecture that expanded my understanding of art. we also had pizza together, which brought me closer to my classmates. And I created an pixel version of an electric toothbrush based on the case study.
